name: Cranium Planet
summary: Sketch, solve, hum, and act it out! Cranium Planet blasts the classic party game onto your living room screen. Gather your favorite people on the couch, scan the QR code, and your phone becomes the controller. Split into Team Red and Team Blue and race your pawns around a vibrant alien world packed with more than 1,000 challenges. Roll the die, move across the planet, and take on activities that put a different talent to the test: doodle an ice cream cone in Cloodle, hum a familiar tune in Humdinger, untangle scrambled letters in Zelpuz, or put your random knowledge to work in Factoid. You might be drawing one turn, solving a puzzle the next, then acting something out while your teammates desperately try to guess what you're doing. And because this is Cranium, you don't have to be great at everything. Artists, performers, puzzle-solvers, trivia buffs, word nerds, and enthusiastic guessers all get their moment. HOW TO PLAY 1. Gather your crew. Play with up to 8 players, or take on Cranium Planet solo. 2. Grab your phones. Scan the on-screen QR code and your phone becomes your personal controller — no extra controllers required. 3. Choose your team. Split into Team Red and Team Blue and get ready to race around the planet. 4. Roll, move, and play. Roll the digital die and take on drawing, performing, word, puzzle, and trivia activities inspired by the classic Cranium experience. 5. Mess with the competition. Fire off Distractions to rattle the other team at just the wrong moment. 6. Race to the finish. Keep completing challenges and moving your pawn. First team around the planet wins! EVERYONE SHINES Cranium has always been about more than knowing the right answer. Want to be center stage? Act and hum in the Star Performer category. Have artistic flair? Sketch masterpieces as a Creative Cat. Data Head is for players who know all sorts of facts, while clever wordsmiths show their stuff with Word Worm puzzles. One challenge might reward the friend who knows something obscure; the next belongs to the doodler, the word wizard, or the friend who's willing to make a complete fool of themselves for the team. YOUR PHONE IS THE CONTROLLER No passing around a controller. Everyone joins with their own phone to draw, answer, choose, flick, and play while the action unfolds together on the big screen. PLAY TOGETHER OR GO SOLO Bring the whole room together for a Team Red vs. Team Blue showdown with up to 8 players, or explore Cranium Planet on your own with solo play. A PLANET THAT KEEPS GROWING With more than 1,000 challenges available at launch, there's already plenty to discover — and the party keeps growing. New content arrives monthly, with fresh prompts and brand-new activities added throughout the year to keep game night fresh. Welcome to Cranium Planet. Everyone shines.
